LESSON: HADITH ON KNOWLEDGE

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Hadith 2.1 Hadith on good Behaviour (3 Lessons) By the end of the sub - strand, 
Topic 2.3: Hadith on Knowledge

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Hadith on Knowledge. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why is it important to seek knowledge in Islam?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. read the Hadith as a source of reference in seeking knowledge
2. appreciate the teachings of the Hadith by working hard in school

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: HADITH ON KNOWLEDGE
This lesson teaches Hadith on Knowledge for Grade 5 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

STUDY STEPS
1. read the Hadith as a source of reference in seeking knowledge
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. appreciate the teachings of the Hadith by working hard in school
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Hadith on Knowledge using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Hadith on Knowledge above.
2. Explain Hadith on Knowledge to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Hadith on Knowledge.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Hadith on Knowledge with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Hadith on Knowledge important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is it important to seek knowledge in Islam?
2. What challenges may hinder one from acquiring education?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. read the Hadith as a source of reference in seeking knowledge
2. appreciate the teachings of the Hadith by working hard in school

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
